final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount) as avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount > 0 GROUP BY e.type), mean_of_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM type_averages) SELECT ta.type, ta.avg_ratio, ta.avg_ratio - ma.mean_ratio as distance_from_mean FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma ORDER BY ta.type
